note: BH-9417.0. Seconds the gh PATH shim serves a PR-, issue- or sha-scoped entry (tag n-<N> or s-<sha12>) past GH_CACHE_TTL_S with no request, while the wake feed is healthy (bin/lib/gh-cache.sh ghc_main): a webhook wake drops a changed object's entry first. It bounds how long a change the worker records no wake for (a label edit by a person) can hide. 0 = off: every entry past the TTL is a conditional request, as before. Resolved like GH_CACHE_TTL_S; code fallback 300.
